title_zh: 核对助理招聘要求并约定准备简历

scenario.label_zh: 助理职位申请要求澄清
scenario.goal_zh: 确认相关经验可以来自志愿工作，找到招聘咨询人并决定准备针对岗位的简历

context_zh: 求职者向工作坊的人事联系人询问已公布的助理岗位。
author: author-phase09-a

sentences.speaker: Leah
sentences.text: Are you still hoping to recruit an assistant for the weekend workshops?

sentences.speaker: Marcus
sentences.text: Yes. The recruitment notice is on our website, and applications stay open until Friday.

sentences.speaker: Leah
sentences.text: My paid work is in a shop. Is my volunteer teaching experience relevant?

sentences.speaker: Marcus
sentences.text: Yes. We need someone who can explain a task clearly to beginners.

sentences.speaker: Leah
sentences.text: Should I include that on my résumé rather than listing every shop duty?

sentences.speaker: Marcus
sentences.text: Include both, but give a clear example from the teaching. Our senior tutor, Eva Chen, can answer questions about the classes.

sentences.speaker: Leah
sentences.text: Could you point me to her work email on the notice?

sentences.speaker: Marcus
sentences.text: It is under the heading "Questions about the role."

sentences.speaker: Leah
sentences.text: Found it. I'll prepare a résumé focused on those examples and contact Eva if I need to clarify the class duties.
